data.name: Updates.Explanation.Windows
data.value: Update offered by Windows Update. Installed without any window; a restore point is created first.

data.name: Updates.Explanation.Driver
data.value: Driver offered by Windows Update. Usually fine, but a new driver can sometimes cause problems: install it if a device misbehaves.

data.name: Updates.Explanation.Optional
data.value: Optional update (preview or extra feature). Not needed for security.

data.name: Updates.Explanation.Upgrade
data.value: New version available through winget, the Windows package manager. Installed silently.

data.name: Updates.Explanation.Install
data.value: Free software installed from its official source through winget, without any window.

data.name: Updates.Intro
data.value: Windows, drivers and your software, updated from one place.

data.name: Updates.WindowsFailed
data.value: Windows Update did not answer. Try again later.

data.name: Updates.WingetMissing
data.value: winget (App Installer) is not installed: install "App Installer" from the Microsoft Store to update your software.

data.name: Updates.WingetFailed
data.value: winget did not answer (network or source problem). Try again later.

data.name: Updates.Reboot
data.value: Restart the PC to finish installing the updates.

data.name: Updates.Searching
data.value: Searching Windows Update can take a few minutes…

data.name: Updates.DriverBackup.Done
data.value: Drivers backed up in {0} (Device Manager > Update driver > Browse to restore one). Done automatically before any driver update.

data.name: Updates.DriverBackup.Failed
data.value: The drivers could not be backed up.

data.name: Updates.Store.Running
data.value: Asking the Microsoft Store to update its apps…

data.name: Updates.Store.Done
data.value: Microsoft Store updates requested: they install in the background over the next minutes.

data.name: Updates.Store.Failed
data.value: The Microsoft Store did not accept the request.
